newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northwest Jan-July runoff forecast at 137 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northwest Jan-July runoff forecast at 137 pct.

text.p: Runoff for January to July on the Columbia River at The Dalles dam in Oregon is now forecast to reach 137 percent of average levels, the Northwest River Forecast Center in Portland said late Thursday.
This latest forecast, an "early-bird" estimate of the center's February update due next week, is even higher than the early January runoff forecast of 130 percent.
Last year, runoff at The Dalles totaled 132 percent of average levels or 139.3 million acre feet (maf).
The 1996 runoff total was the largest since 1974 and the fourth largest in 66 years of record-keeping, the center said.
The forecast for 1997 now stands at 145 maf.
The Dalles, the second-to-last hydroelectric project on the Columbia, is generally used at the benchmark for regional runoff due to its location and long historical record.
